extracted_resume.name: Rajesh Govindarajan
extracted_resume.summary:
Strategic IT Leader and Principal Engineer with over 20 years of experience architecting distributed systems 
and over 2 years building large-scale, production-grade agentic AI systems. Expert in multi-agent orchestration 
architectures, AI Agents, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems for customer-facing conversational 
AI products. Proven track record of shipping features that drive engagement as well as building and scaling 
high-performing AI engineering teams. Adept at bridging technical complexity with product strategy and 
business outcomes across cross-functional organizations. 
Core Skills 
 
●​
Strategic Leadership: AI Roadmapping, Cross-functional Team Scaling, Build vs. Buy Governance, Enterprise AI 
Transformation.  
●​
Agentic Systems: Multi-agent orchestration & coordination | LangGraph | Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocols, Memory 
architectures (short-term context, long-term customer memory) | Stateful AI agents | Prompt engineering, fine-tuning & 
post-training strategies 
●​
AI & ML: Agentic framworks: Langgraph, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel | Interruptable voice Agent | Conversational AI 
systems | Pytorch, TensorFlow 
●​
Enterprise Architecture: Cloud Strategy (AWS/Azure/GCP), API-First Design, Legacy System Modernization 
(AS400/Mainframe).
